001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
006
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherFactory;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher.BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
011
012/**
013 * Registry of publishers. Rainbow Gum registers default publishers with the following
014 * schemes:
015 * <ul>
016 * <li>{@value #SYNC_SCHEME} - default sync publisher</li>
017 * <li>{@value #ASYNC_SCHEME} - default async publisher</li>
018 * <li>{@value #BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME} - {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher}</li>
019 * <li>{@value #DEFAULT_SCHEME} - by default this is the same as
020 * {@link #SYNC_SCHEME}.</li>
021 * </ul>
022 * Plugins may override the above so that the above is automatically replaced with other
023 * providers via the service loader.
024 *
025 * @see RainbowGumServiceProvider
026 */
027public sealed interface LogPublisherRegistry extends LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
028
029        /**
030         * Register a publisher provider by URI scheme.
031         * @param scheme uri scheme.
032         * @param publisherProvider provider.
033         */
034        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider);
035
036        /**
037         * This is URI scheme for the async publisher used by the publisher builder. Call
038         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
039         * this scheme to replace the default async publisher.
040         * <p>
041         * A module registering a replacement must support the {@value #BUFFER_SIZE_NAME} URI
042         * query parameter. Both {@link PublisherFactory#ofAsync(Integer)} and
043         * {@link LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher.Builder#bufferSize(int)} pass the requested
044         * capacity through that parameter. The corresponding named property is
045         * {@value #BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY}.
046         */
047        public static String ASYNC_SCHEME = "async";
048
049        /**
050         * Explicit scheme for {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher}, independent of which
051         * implementation is registered as the default {@link #ASYNC_SCHEME} publisher.
052         */
053        public static String BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME = "batchswap";
054
055        /**
056         * This is the URI scheme for the sync publisher builder to find a sync publisher.
057         * Call {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)}
058         * with this scheme to replace the default sync publisher.
059         */
060        public static String SYNC_SCHEME = "sync";
061
062        /**
063         * This is the URI scheme for the default publisher.
064         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
065         * this scheme to replace the default publisher.
066         */
067        public static String DEFAULT_SCHEME = "default";
068
069        /**
070         * Because publisher configurators through service provider discovery can replace the
071         * default schemes of {@link #ASYNC_SCHEME}, {@link #SYNC_SCHEME} all the builtin core
072         * providers are prefixed with this value so that they can still be used even if
073         * overriden.
074         */
075        public static String BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX = "core.";
076
077        /**
078         * Default async buffer size.
079         */
080        public static final int ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
081
082        /**
083         * Buffer Size property name.
084         */
085        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_NAME = "bufferSize";
086
087        /**
088         * Buffer Size Property for Async publishers.
089         */
090        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + BUFFER_SIZE_NAME;
091
092        /**
093         * Default time in milliseconds an async publisher's close waits for queued events to
094         * be written.
095         */
096        public static final int ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = 10_000;
097
098        /**
099         * Shutdown timeout property name.
100         */
101        public static final String SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_NAME = "shutdownTimeout";
102
103        /**
104         * Milliseconds an async publisher's close waits for queued events to be written.
105         */
106        public static final String SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_PROPERTY = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_NAME;
107
108}
109
110final class DefaultPublisherRegistry implements LogPublisherRegistry {
111
112        private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, PublisherProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider>();
113
114        @Override
115        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
116                ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
117                var uri = ref.uri();
118                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
119                if (scheme == null) {
120                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is missing scheme. uri: " + uri);
121                }
122                var provider = providers.get(scheme);
123                if (provider == null) {
124                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.PUBLISHER, scheme, uri);
125                }
126                return provider.provide(ref);
127        }
128
129        @Override
130        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider) {
131                providers.put(scheme, publisherProvider);
132        }
133
134        /**
135         * Creates a publisher registry instance.
136         * @return publisher registry.
137         */
138        static LogPublisherRegistry of() {
139                var r = new DefaultPublisherRegistry();
140                for (var p : DefaultPublisherProviders.values()) {
141                        r.register(p.scheme(), p);
142                        r.register(BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX + p.scheme(), p);
143                }
144                return r;
145        }
146
147}
148
149enum DefaultPublisherProviders implements LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
150
151        DEFAULT {
152                @Override
153                public String scheme() {
154                        return LogPublisherRegistry.DEFAULT_SCHEME;
155                }
156
157                @Override
158                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
159                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
160                }
161        },
162        SYNC {
163                @Override
164                public String scheme() {
165                        return LogPublisherRegistry.SYNC_SCHEME;
166                }
167
168                @Override
169                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
170                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
171                }
172
173        },
174        ASYNC {
175
176                @Override
177                public String scheme() {
178                        return LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SCHEME;
179                }
180
181                @Override
182                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
183                        return BATCH_SWAP.provide(name, properties);
184                }
185        },
186        BATCH_SWAP {
187
188                @Override
189                public String scheme() {
190                        return LogPublisherRegistry.BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME;
191                }
192
193                @Override
194                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
195                        return BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.builder(name).fromProperties(properties).build();
196                }
197        };
198
199        @Override
200        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
201                return (n, config, appenders) -> provide(ref.uri(), n, config.properties()).create(n, config, appenders);
202        }
203
204        public abstract String scheme();
205
206        protected abstract PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties);
207
208        public PublisherFactory provide(URI uri, String name, LogProperties properties) {
209                String prefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX, Map.of(LogProperties.NAME, name));
210                LogProperties combined = LogProperties.of(uri, prefix, properties);
211                return provide(name, combined);
212        }
213
214}
